feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 03 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure to the west of Ireland as various fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, increasing 5 in some places, becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 overnight and occasionally 6 towards the North Channel. Veering south or southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow and touching force 6 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers approaching from the south and then clearing later. Areas of mist and fog patches in places tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain, showers and mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, increasing 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated mist and fog patches in the east at first, otherwise mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but poor or very poor in mist and fog patches at first.
